dialogue.t: This is the cave where Aphimead is brewed. Quite the sight, isn't it?
You're here for the brewing ceremony, right? Welcome.
Although, there's been a small problem with the preparations... Some monsters found their way into the Brewblossoms used in the brewing process, and now no one dares venture to the lower levels.
Would you be so kind as to go down there and help us deal with them?
We would be in your debt.
Thank you! All the pollen has been absorbed.
The brewing ceremony is complete. Time to begin the show!
(test)这个场地终于筹备完成啦，欢迎你们
(test)那个绿色的家伙在里面等着你们哦
(test)You're finally here, Traveler... However, there's been a minor situation with the preparations here. A minor one, really.
(test)But I heard that mead brewing is a part of the celebrations anyway. Why don't you join me in trying it out, Traveler?
